entities.name: Sultan Mehmed mosque, Arta, Epirus, Greece
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Sultan Mehmed Mosque, also known as the Suleyman Agha Mosque, was mosque in the town of Arta, in the Epirus region of Greece, built within the Castle of Arta. Completed in the c. 15th century, during the Ottoman era, it was one of the eight mosques of the town, and one of the six that are no longer extant.
